page.overview:
Who is Moon Devil?

The の|Tsuki no Akuma}} is a Devil who embodies the concept of the Moon.

The Moon Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

The Moon Devil's personality is currently unknown.

The Moon Devil was first mentioned by Yoru to explain the wave of suicides involving people jumping from buildings, as well as the inversion of gravity that caused numerous individuals to fall towards the sky. Both phenomena were ultimately caused by the appearance of the Falling Devil.
